name: Playwright
description: Playwright's own MCP server, run on the machine Polyth runs on. It gives the agent a browser it can actually operate: forms, signed-out public sites and visual checks. It needs Node.js and downloads a browser on first start.

probe.note: Invocation from the vendor's documentation, pinned to @playwright/mcp@0.0.85, the newest stable release published on 2026-11-11. The catalog never starts it unpinned.
